說明: 《千秋硯》卷四〈雅典〉生圖清單（回一）。畫風、節點、尺寸沿用卷一清單。注意：雅典建築依考古復原（白色大理石神廟只在衛城，民宅是泥磚與夯土），衣著是羊毛或亞麻的披衣與短袍，不要羅馬式的盔甲與拱門。

items.name: 比雷埃夫斯港
items.prompt: Ancient Athens in 404 BC at the end of the Peloponnesian War: the great harbor of Piraeus, many long narrow wooden warships (triremes) with three banks of oar ports pulled up onto slipways under shed roofs, their paint peeling, almost no people working; thin hungry people sitting along the quay staring at the sea; out at sea a blockading fleet with foreign sails; two long fortification walls run inland toward a distant hill crowned with a white temple. People wear simple draped wool or linen garments (chiton and himation) and sandals or bare feet; ordinary houses are low mud-brick and rubble buildings with tiled roofs. No Roman armor, no arches, no domes, no marble everywhere.

items.name: 長牆
items.prompt: Ancient Athens in 404 BC at the end of the Peloponnesian War: a wide dusty road running between two very long parallel fortification walls of stone base and mud-brick upper courses, stretching into the distance toward the city and a hill crowned with a white temple; crude tents and shelters of refugees from the countryside crowded along the road; pale spring light. People wear simple draped wool or linen garments (chiton and himation) and sandals or bare feet; ordinary houses are low mud-brick and rubble buildings with tiled roofs. No Roman armor, no arches, no domes, no marble everywhere.

items.name: 陶器區
items.prompt: Ancient Athens in 404 BC at the end of the Peloponnesian War: the potters' quarter (Kerameikos) outside the city gate: low workshops with smoking domed kilns, rows of finished red-figure and black-figure vases and unfired grey clay pots drying in the sun on wooden shelves, potter's wheels, piles of broken sherds, a girl sitting in a doorway painting a vase with a fine brush. People wear simple draped wool or linen garments (chiton and himation) and sandals or bare feet; ordinary houses are low mud-brick and rubble buildings with tiled roofs. No Roman armor, no arches, no domes, no marble everywhere.

items.name: 市集廣場
items.prompt: Ancient Athens in 404 BC at the end of the Peloponnesian War: the Agora, a large open square surrounded by long colonnaded stoas with painted walls and simple Doric columns, a few half-empty market stalls, people sitting and talking in the shade of the colonnades, a small temple on a low hill at one side, plane trees, warm afternoon light. People wear simple draped wool or linen garments (chiton and himation) and sandals or bare feet; ordinary houses are low mud-brick and rubble buildings with tiled roofs. No Roman armor, no arches, no domes, no marble everywhere.

items.name: 尼科
items.prompt: A 25-year-old Athenian rower, very thin from hunger but broad-shouldered, sun-darkened skin, short messy dark hair and a short beard, thick calluses on his hands, a worn short wool tunic, a broken oar over his shoulder, a wide open grin showing one small pointed canine tooth, warm despite hardship.

items.name: 菲莉
items.prompt: A 17-year-old Greek girl of a potter's family in ancient Athens, dark hair tied back, a simple linen chiton smeared with clay, holding a very fine brush and a small unfired vase, sharp curious eyes and a stubborn mouth.

items.name: 蘇格拉底
items.prompt: An elderly Athenian man around 66 years old, short and stout, a snub nose, bulging wide-set eyes, a bald head with a full grey beard, barefoot, wearing a single shabby old wool cloak, a merry, probing, kindly expression as if about to ask a question.

items.name: 沉槳
items.prompt: A tangle of broken wooden oars rising from dark sea water, seaweed and barnacles on them, ghostly hands faintly gripping their handles, dripping and cold.

items.name: 空倉
items.prompt: An empty storage room of clay storage jars (pithoi) and empty grain sacks come alive as a hollow gaunt figure, dust instead of grain pouring from it, desolate.

items.name: 陶片魅
items.prompt: A swirling cluster of reddish-brown broken pottery sherds, each scratched with crude Greek letters, forming a hovering creature like a flock, menacing.

items.name: 笛聲魅
items.prompt: A floating pair of ancient Greek double reed pipes (aulos) trailing bright cheerful ribbons of sound waves, beneath which faint grieving faces dissolve; eerie contrast of joy and sorrow.

items.name: 羊河之殤
items.prompt: A dark ghostly fleet of long narrow ancient warships rising from black water, made of shadow and sea foam, many faint faces of rowers along the oar ports, silent and mournful.

items.name: 傾牆
items.prompt: A colossal collapsing fortification wall of stone and mud brick rising up like a giant leaning over to fall, cracks spreading, dust pouring, ribbons of flute music swirling around it, the sound of a whole city sighing.

items.name: 笛聲
items.prompt: Ancient Athens in 404 BC at the end of the Peloponnesian War: Spartan soldiers with long hair and red cloaks and their allies pulling down a section of the long fortification wall with ropes and levers while girls play double reed pipes (aulos) cheerfully; stones crashing down in dust; thin silent Athenians in plain cloaks watching from the roadside, a young man with a broken oar and a girl with clay on her dress among them; ironic festive yet heartbreaking. People wear simple draped wool or linen garments (chiton and himation) and sandals or bare feet; ordinary houses are low mud-brick and rubble buildings with tiled roofs. No Roman armor, no arches, no domes, no marble everywhere.

items.name: 亞里斯提德的陶片
items.prompt: Ancient Athens 404 BC, inside a potter's workshop lit by a small clay oil lamp: a 17-year-old girl holds out a small open wooden box containing a reddish-brown pottery sherd with crude scratched letters, showing it to a young man in a draped cloak and a thin broad-shouldered young rower; shelves of vases behind; warm and quiet; letters indistinct.
